versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the method-conventions-diagnostic skill for psychology research writing.
- Diagnoses academic convention issues in Method sections: citation placement & attribution, accurate Option 1/2/3 method referencing, ethics & transparency reporting, and consistent terminology/format.
- Applies rules from Science Research Writing (2nd ed.) Unit 2, including citation location, passive/active voice for attribution, and details for IRB, consent, TOP/JARS standards.
- Uses comprehensive checklist, grading rubric with levels/severity, and over 50 top journal examples for robust benchmarking.
- Outputs a dimensional evaluation with scores, major issue flags, and positive article references for improvement.
